description: This is a classic wingback armchair upholstered in a vibrant red and off-white plaid fabric. The chair features a tall, supportive back with distinctive winged sides, and gently curved armrests, providing an inviting and comfortable appearance. It has a removable seat cushion and is supported by four short, dark block feet. The plaid pattern is composed of broad red bands crossed by narrower off-white stripes, giving it a cozy and traditional aesthetic.
